question: For each degree-granting department (excluding the Biology department (Course 7) and the Physics department), what is the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for letter-graded subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, as well as the maximum total units and subject title for any subject offered by that department in 2024 that is offered this year and has more than 9 total units, and also provide the course description for that subject? List the department name, average total units, range of total units, variance of total units, maximum total units in 2024, subject title, and course description in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH Dept2022Stats AS (
  SELECT 
    sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units,
    MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units,
    VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso
  JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022'
    AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L'
    AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('7', '8')
  GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
Max2024Subject AS (
  SELECT 
    ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    ccso.TOTAL_UNITS,
    ccso.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ccso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC) AS rn
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso
  JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2024'
    AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
    AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9
    AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('7', '8')
)
SELECT 
  d22.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d22.avg_total_units,
  d22.range_total_units,
  d22.var_total_units,
  m24.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_total_units_2024,
  m24.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  m24.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION AS course_description
FROM Dept2022Stats d22
LEFT JOIN Max2024Subject m24 ON d22.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m24.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND m24.rn = 1
ORDER BY d22.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics'), MathDeptUnitStats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND NOT TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.LECTURE_UNITS, CASE WHEN NOT ccs.JOINT_SUBJECTS IS NULL AND TRIM(ccs.JOINT_SUBJECTS) <> '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_JOINT_SUBJECT, mds.total_units_range, mds.total_units_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccs ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MathDeptUnitStats AS mds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID

WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC), PoliSciHGNStats AS (SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2), DeptSubjectTotals AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_units, d.units_variance, NULL AS HGN_CODE, NULL AS max_lecture_units, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS total_subjects, 'DeptUnitsStats' AS Source FROM DeptUnitsStats AS d UNION ALL SELECT p.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_units, NULL AS units_variance, p.HGN_CODE, p.max_lecture_units, p.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS total_subjects, 'PoliSciHGNStats' AS Source FROM PoliSciHGNStats AS p UNION ALL SELECT t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_units, NULL AS units_variance, NULL AS HGN_CODE, NULL AS max_lecture_units, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, t.total_subjects, 'DeptSubjectTotals' AS Source FROM DeptSubjectTotals AS t) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Source

WITH DeptBudgetStddev AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_budget_code_stddev, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, d1.dept_budget_code_stddev, d1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2.avg_total_units, d2.range_total_units, d2.var_total_units, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM DeptBudgetStddev AS d1 JOIN DeptUnitsStats AS d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE AS TIP_TERM_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE (lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = 928034000 OR tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')), dept_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_grad_subjects, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, icte.TIP_TERM_CODE, icte.LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, icte.TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, icte.MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.enrolled_range, ds.enrolled_variance, ds.num_grad_subjects FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN dept_stats AS ds ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH max_units_by_dept AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = icte.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE), kevin_eecs_students AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t2.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, MIN(t0.COURSE_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t2.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin' AND t2.DEPARTMENT = '6') SELECT inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, inner_cte.window_column, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT FROM inner_cte JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT mud.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mud.max_total_units, mud.SUBJECT_TITLE, mud.SCHOOL_NAME, kes.FULL_NAME, kes.EMAIL_ADDRESS, kes.STUDENT_YEAR, kes.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, kes.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, kes.COURSE_LEVEL, kes.window_column, kes.SCHOOL_NAME AS STUDENT_SCHOOL_NAME, kes.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM max_units_by_dept AS mud JOIN kevin_eecs_students AS kes ON mud.DEPARTMENT_CODE = kes.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY mud.DEPARTMENT_NAME, kes.FULL_NAME

WITH MathCourses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.GRADE_TYPE, MAX(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.COURSE ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), DeptUnitsVariance AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT mc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mc.SCHOOL_NAME, mc.COURSE_LEVEL, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.TOTAL_UNITS, mc.GRADE_TYPE, mc.MAX_ACADEMIC_YEAR, duv.total_units_variance FROM MathCourses AS mc JOIN DeptUnitsVariance AS duv ON mc.DEPARTMENT = duv.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY mc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY i.subject_count, i.min_term_start_date, d.avg_subject_count, CASE WHEN i.subject_count > d.avg_subject_count * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.subject_count < d.avg_subject_count * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'WITHIN_10_PERCENT' END AS subject_count_category FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.department = d.department), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), subq2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte2 WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata2 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso2 ON ata2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.TERM_CODE WHERE ata2.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata2.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%')) SELECT s1.department, s1.academic_year, s1.subject_count, s1.min_term_start_date, s1.avg_subject_count, s1.subject_count_category, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.academic_year = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.department, s1.academic_year

WITH dg AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT, DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION
  WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND DEPARTMENT NOT IN ('7','8')
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    c.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units,
    MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_units,
    VAR_SAMP(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_units
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022'
    AND c.GRADE_TYPE_DESC = 'Letter graded'
    AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT FROM dg)
  GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
max2024 AS (
  SELECT
    c.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_units,
    MAX(CONCAT(c.TOTAL_UNITS, '||', IFNULL(c.SUBJECT_TITLE,''))) AS title_key
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2024'
    AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
    AND c.TOTAL_UNITS > 9
    AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT FROM dg)
  GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
)
SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  s.avg_units,
  s.range_units,
  s.var_units,
  m.max_units,
  SUBSTRING_INDEX(m.title_key, '||', -1) AS subject_title,
  (SELECT c2.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION
   FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c2
   WHERE c2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2024'
     AND c2.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
     AND c2.TOTAL_UNITS > 9
     AND c2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE
     AND c2.TOTAL_UNITS = m.max_units
   LIMIT 1) AS course_description
FROM dg d
JOIN stats s ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT
LEFT JOIN max2024 m ON m.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT
ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
